''See also: [[Imperial Guards Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Imperial Guard]] is a highly numerous and widespread [[Imperial]] [[Guild]] characterized by its red-and-black uniforms, which feature the [[Aurelian]] Shield crest. Known for their extreme loyalty to the Emperor and their intense paranoia, they serve as a primary security force responsible for patrolling storehouses, settling riots, and securing the borders of the [[Imperial]] Palace. While some other elite guilds may view them as having lower entry requirements suited for mundane tasks, the Guard is widely recognized for its ability to detect intruders and its constant vigilance. A defining feature of the [[Guild]] is that its members are alchemically enhanced with parts from [[Kameira]]. These biological integrations—such as talons, extra limbs, specialized eyes, or various animalistic traits—grant them enhanced physical abilities and heightened senses, though these modifications often result in monstrous or unusual appearances. This process also serves as a [[binding]] mechanism to the [[Guild]], as these altered individuals are often not accepted elsewhere. [[The Guild]] is led by General [[Jarelys Teach]], a formidable figure who rose to power through combat and possesses immense strength despite appearing human. The stability of the [[Imperial Guard]] is intrinsically tied to the presence of a true Emperor; without one, the organization faces potential collapse. While they are considered the most loyal of the [[Imperial Guilds]], their morale and direction can shift based on the [[Authority|authority]] of those currently holding power.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Imperial]] [[Guards]], who possess [[Kameira enhancements]], were observed using weapons to cut at the [[Elder wall]]. Following a conflict, wounded members of the unit were seen cleaning [[Elderspawn]] gore from the [[courtyard]] while others struggled to their feet and called for backup. During these events, the guards tended to the [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]] and seized [[Lucan]] at weapon point. While some guards stationed at the [[armory]] displayed physical traits such as six-fingered hands, muscled arms, and crocodile-like teeth, the unit was positioned outside the doors when [[Meia]] disappeared. Ultimately, the guards leaped from ships onto the [[Gray Island]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Wounded [[Imperial Guards]] were cleaning up [[Elderspawn]] gore in the [[courtyard]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c10">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Clad in black and red uniforms, the [[Imperial]] [[Guards]] possess enhanced senses. During the coronation ceremony, they fill the sky, and later, they serve as escorts for [[Calder]]. When [[Calder]] calls for assistance, the guards respond, with some members appearing bandaged while tending to the injured. The unit can be found standing at the bottom of a ramp, though most are engaged in combat aboard [[Navigator]] vessels.}}
